snippet.title: Battle Planes: Multiplayer - Official Trailer (new hand-drawn look)
snippet.description:
Hide your 3 planes. Find theirs before they find yours.
Battle Planes is the paper planes game from school, now online. Play the classic planes or the new hand-drawn notebook look, find a deskmate online or play a friend in a private room.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373790
Free on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ducttapegames.battleplanes
Play in your browser: https://battleplanes.itch.io/battle-planes
